_comment: Bureau-report API endpoint for the app_api.py entry. The endpoint returns
the AECB payload document itself for a POSTed {"cbSubjectId": "..."}.
base_url is the full endpoint URL, exactly as in the integration Postman
collection. It is an INTERNAL host on the deployment network -- never a
public one; bureau subject ids must not be routable off the estate.
Credentials are NOT kept here. The service account (IIS Windows
authentication, NTLMv2) is read from the server process environment:
AECB_API_USERNAME, AECB_API_DOMAIN and AECB_API_PASSWORD. A file that
still carries an "auth" block is refused. See docs/OPERATIONS.md.
A missing or malformed file fails loudly in the app -- an API entry that
silently pointed nowhere would read as 'subject not found' and mislead.
